title: fix(types,plugin-form): a file/image field's size limit is `maxSize`, the spec's one spelling (objectui#12156)
body:
Fixes #12156
Clause-②: yes

A `file` or `image` field's size limit now has one spelling, `maxSize`, the spec's `FieldSchema.maxSize`. The docs taught `max_size`, the two field metadata interfaces declared it, and no widget read it, so a limit written the way the pages showed was accepted and then did nothing. The direction is triage's grade on the card (comment `6112533852`): rename `max_size`, remove `max_files` / `max_width` / `max_height`, no alias, no dual read (AGENTS.md #0.1).

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/types`, `FileFieldMetadata` and `ImageFieldMetadata`.** `max_size?: number` becomes `maxSize?: SpecField['maxSize']`, by reference to the spec, the same form `FormField.maxSize` already uses. `max_files` is removed from both interfaces, and `max_width` / `max_height` from the image one. They are removed, not renamed: no reader exists in either spelling and `FieldSchema` declares no twin.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form`, the flat `ObjectForm`.** The file-size hint, the block that appends "Max size: ..." to a `file` / `image` field's description, reads `field.maxSize` and no longer reads `field.max_size`.
- **Docs.** The `file` and `image` field pages teach `maxSize`, drop the three removed keys, and say that no file-count or pixel-dimension key exists.
- **Changesets.** `@object-ui/types` minor, with the four-key break stated FROM → TO. `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch.

Producer side: the declarations and the two pages are the producers, as the claim expected. The widgets (`FileField`, `ImageField`) already read `maxSize` and are not touched.

## Premise checks, on `main` `26b0bd2`

- **A1, the `ObjectForm` hint.** `field` there is untyped (`objectSchema` is a `useState` of `any`), so a misspelt read compiles. The hint read `max_size`, which the spec refuses by name, so metadata the server serves never carried it and the hint never showed. The new pin `objectFormFileSizeHint-12156.test.tsx` is what catches a wrong read now.
- **A2, census of the three removed keys.** `git grep -n -E 'max_size|max_files|max_width|max_height'` over the whole tree gave 20 hits: the two docs pages (10), `field-types.ts` (6), the `ObjectForm` hint (2), and the chatbot prompt input's attachment error code `"max_files"` (2). That last one is a different surface and is not a field metadata reader. The camelCase twins: `maxFiles` lives only on `FileUploadSchema` and the chatbot prompt input, which is the upload component surface triage put out of scope. `maxWidth` / `maxHeight` hits are container, CSS and chatbot props. So there is no live reader of the three keys in either spelling, and the stop condition did not fire.
- **A3.** `field-types.ts` already imports `type { Field as SpecField }` from `@objectstack/spec/data` (for `FieldDependsOn`). There is no new dependency.
- **A4, doc gates.** `check:doc-snippets` compiles both pages' `ts` blocks against the built `@object-ui/types` d.ts. The ablation below shows the old spelling now goes red there. `check:doc-types` judges only the `type` literal. `check:doc-examples` and `check:doc-json` do not read these keys.
- **A5.** The one consumer of these interfaces in `packages/fields` is the test `file-value.bare-percent-10614.test.tsx`. It uses none of the four keys. The `fields` suite and its `type-check` are green.
- **A6.** No hit for the four keys under `skills/**`. Its only related key is `maxSize`, already the spec spelling. Nothing was edited there.
- **The spec's own door** (installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0): `FieldSchema.safeParse` accepts the docs' `file` and `image` literals with `maxSize` kept. On both types it refuses each of the four snake keys with `unrecognized_keys` naming the key, and it refuses `maxFiles` too.

## Pins

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/field-file-image-max-size-12156.test.ts`. At the type level, read by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: `maxSize` equals `SpecField['maxSize']` on both interfaces and is not `any`. None of the four keys is a member. A fresh annotated literal carries `maxSize`. A string `maxSize` is refused. Each of the four retired keys is refused on a fresh literal (`@ts-expect-error`, one key per literal, because TypeScript reports only the first excess property). At runtime: `FieldSchema` accepts both typed literals, and it refuses each retired key by name.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormFileSizeHint-12156.test.tsx`, through the public `ObjectForm` with the real registered widgets. A `file` field with `maxSize` shows "Max size: 10.0 MB". An `image` field keeps its authored description before the hint. A field carrying only `max_size` shows no hint. CONTROL: a field with no limit shows no hint.

## Ablations (each run on the committed implementation, restored and proven: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)

1. `ObjectForm` read reverted from `field.maxSize` to `field.max_size`. The hint pin goes 3 failed / 1 passed, and the one that passes is the control.
2. `field-types.ts` reverted to the four snake members (both `maxSize` declarations replaced). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exits 2 with 15 errors, all in the new pin: `maxSize` missing, both `Equal` assertions false, and the six retired-key `@ts-expect-error` directives unused.
3. `image.mdx`'s block reverted to `max_size` against the new built types. `check:doc-snippets` exits 1: `TS2561: Object literal may only specify known properties, but 'max_size' does not exist in type 'ImageFieldMetadata'. Did you mean to write 'maxSize'?`, 1 of 789 blocks failed.

## Gates, on `2a01fd0` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`)

Each line gives the exit code and the gate's own verdict.

- Under the verify lock: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` exit 0: `Test Files 370 passed (370)`, `Tests 10195 passed`. `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/ packages/fields/` exit 0: `Test Files 424 passed | 1 skipped (425)`, `Tests 6158 passed | 8 skipped`. `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/` exit 0: `Test Files 180 passed | 2 skipped (182)`, `Tests 5489 passed | 2 skipped`.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-form`, all three echoed, exit 0. It ran after `turbo run build` of the doc-snippet `--build-filter` closure (35 of 35 tasks successful). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists each new pin once (types: 1, plugin-form: 1).
- `check:doc-snippets` 0 (789 of 789 judged, 0 failed). `check:doc-examples` 0. `check:doc-types` 0. `check:doc-json` 0. `check:doc-example-ids` 0. `check:doc-fences` 0. `check:docs-route-closure` 0. `check:doc-example-readers` 0. `check-doc-links` 0.
- `check:readme-exports` 0, after the build. Run before the build it was NOT MEASURED, because the population collapsed on unbuilt packages. `check:spec-symbols` 0. `check:designer-field-key-parity` 0. `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new citations). `check:control-bytes` 0. `check:test-path-roots` 0. `type-check:coverage` 0. `check:published-dist` 0. `check:changeset-claims` 0. `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0. `changeset:check` 0. `check-changeset-presence` 0 (4 source files of 2 released packages, 2 changesets). `check-changeset-no-major` 0.
- Narrowed lint, in place of the repo-wide run, which is CI's. `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the four changed TS files reports 4 files, 0 errors and 59 warnings. All the warnings are `no-explicit-any` / `react-hooks` readings, and all but two are pre-existing lines. The two new ones are the `as any` casts in the hint pin, the sibling `serverDefaultHint-12108.test.tsx` pattern. All four files are in eslint's population: each returned rule results, not an ignore notice. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService` / `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file. The `.mdx` and changeset files are not linted.
- README census: no package README names any of the four keys or either interface. The positive control, `@object-ui/types` in the types README, has 20 hits.

## Acceptance notes

- **The hint is English-only.** "Max size: ..." is a literal template that does not go through `t()`. Before this change it fired only for metadata carrying the retired `max_size`, which the server never serves. Now it fires for any field declaring `maxSize`. A scratch render under a `zh` `I18nProvider` (not committed) showed the form's submit button reading 创建 while the hint read "Max size: 10.0 MB". A translated hint needs a new pack key in every built-in locale of `@object-ui/i18n`, which is outside this claim's file surface. This is raised in the dev report for the seat.
- **`help` on field metadata.** The `file` page's `FileFieldMetadata` literal also carries `help:`, which `BaseFieldMetadata` declares and the spec's `FieldSchema` refuses by name (`unrecognized_keys`; the spec spells it `description` / `inlineHelpText`). It is a different key and not on this card, so it is left as is and raised in the dev report.
- objectui#12157 (same seat, this round) may touch `LookupFieldMetadata` in `field-types.ts`, a disjoint region. Whichever lands second merges `main`.
